correctness.rationale: In characteristic two, the three Hasse jets of (1,t,t²,t³,t⁴) yield the stated incidence map. Direct substitution annihilates F=x0²x3⁴+x1⁴x4²+x0x2⁴x4+x0³x4³, and a generically nonzero 3×3 incidence Jacobian gives dimension three. The affine quartic in x3 has nonsquare right-hand side in k(x1,x2,x4), ensuring irreducibility. The exact polynomial identity F=H²+x0x4 G² forces gradient components x4G² and x0G² only. Syzygies K²=x0H+x1²G and x0L=x1G+x2K and the x0=0/x4!=0 chart show all reduced singular points lie in the plane P or the cubic scroll S=V(G,K,L). Four affine charts cover S and are smooth; P∩S has reduced line x0=x2=x4=0. This proves codimension-one singularity and nonnormality, without claiming scheme-reduced intersection. Independent symbolic modulo-two identities confirmed.
